records.move: from Chief Legal Advisor and Company Secretary, then Chief Support Officer, of Bank of Bhutan Limited (September 2008 to December 2014), via Chief General Counsel of the National Pension & Provident Fund, to Chief General Counsel of the Royal Monetary Authority
records.summary: His official profile dates his roles at Bank of Bhutan Limited from September 2008 to December 2014, then the National Pension and Provident Fund to May 2016, then the Royal Monetary Authority from June 2016.
